## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Sections affected

- [ ] Hero and navigation
- [ ] Services or process
- [ ] Metrics or specialties
- [ ] Human accountability story
- [ ] Audit form, FAQ, or footer
- [ ] Project infrastructure only

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Desktop behavior checked
- [ ] Mobile behavior checked
- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior checked
- [ ] Reduced-motion behavior checked

## Review material

Add screenshots, a preview link, or design context when the change is visual.
